commits_info.message:
2.27.5 release (previous 2.27.4) + release notes updated by CI build 4115

[ci skip-release]

Fixes #1717: configure the MethodVisitor for Java 11+ compatibility (#1718)

By using Byte Buddy's supported ASM API version, the visitor will always be
compatible with the currently supported bytecode, including when using the
experimental feature.

[ci maven-central-release]

Fixes #298: replaces Objenesis references from stubbing classes with plugin equivalents. (#1715)

* Replaces Objenesis references from stubbing support with plugin calls.

This enables the iOS Mockito plugin
(https://github.com/google/j2objc/tree/master/testing/mockito) to upgrade to v2.

* Added unit test to verify core classes do not depend on bytecode libraries.
Fixes #1713: fix typo in Mockito.java javadoc (#1714)
Migrate junitJupiterExtensionTest subproject to kotlin dsl (#1704)

Fixes #1623 : Rename TooLittleActualInvocations (#1708)

Rename the exception TooLittleActualInvocations to
TooFewActualInvocations as this is more correct English. As this
exception is public API, we rename by subclassing and deprecating the
original. Rename all tests and internal methods that were referencing
the old name by aligning with the new name.
Change master to release/3.x in pull request template (#1707)
Remove no longer relevant code from settings.gradle.kts (#1705)
Use require instead of assert in settings.gradle (#1703)
